subject: Hosted API quickstart — post-demo technical follow-up and rate plan
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily@bluemap.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API quickstart — follow-up and next steps

Thanks again for joining the demo this morning, Emily — really appreciated the candid discussion about BlueMap's latency targets and data residency needs. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary from call:
- Primary goal: integrate hosted text-generation for customer-facing search assist and ticket triage.
- SLO targets: p95 latency <= 300ms for short prompts (~18 tokens), burst tolerance for marketing campaigns.
- Data residency: US-only logs for now; potential EU later.
- Security: SOC 2 report requested; will send standard package.

Hosted evaluation quickstart (what we'll provide by EOD):
1) Trial access: demo API key + sandbox endpoints (read-only rate of 60 req/min by default).
2) Endpoints: streaming and non-streaming text generation, embed endpoint for search similarity.
3) Sample requests & cURL snippets + SDK snippets (Python/Node).
4) Trial ratecard and a short mutual action plan that maps milestones to owners.

Questions we still need from your side (short answers ok):
- Typical prompt length (tokens) and expected response length? Rough averages are fine.
- Expected steady-state RPS and peak burst RPS for the first 3 months.
- Any redlines for IP/data handling or specific contract clauses we should surface early?

Attachments: I attached the quickstart instructions and the trial ratecard. The mutual-action-plan has an initial timeline — feel free to edit.

Next meetings:
- Tech deep-dive: propose Thurs 3/9 10:00 PT with our solutions engineer (Lauren) to map endpoint mapping and rate knobs.
- Procurement intro (if helpful): we can include procurement@bluemap.com on the MPA.

If that all looks sane I’ll provision keys and post the sandbox endpoints.

Best,
Nikhil
Senior Solutions Executive
Redwood Inference


From: Emily Chen <emily@bluemap.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueMap DevOps <devops@bluemap.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API quickstart — follow-up and next steps

Thanks, Nikhil — great demo. Quick answers inline: 

- Prompt/response sizes: average prompt ~45 tokens (search context + user query), average response ~90 tokens for triage suggestions.
- Traffic: steady-state ~12 RPS across peak hours, expected bursts to ~120 RPS during promos (lasting ~10-20 minutes). First 3 months conservative estimate: 0.5M tokens/day.
- Contract: procurement will want standard security addenda; SOC 2 + network architecture diagram would be great. No major IP pushback for inference-only calls.

We can do Thursday 3/9 10:00 PT for a technical call — Lauren is welcome. One ask: can you confirm whether hosted trial keys support streaming WebSocket vs only HTTP chunked? Our front-end team prefers streaming WS for lower latency UX.

Also looping in procurement (procurement@bluemap.com) — they'll review the MPA and ratecard.

—Emily
Director, Platform Engineering
BlueMap Solutions

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily@bluemap.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, procurement@bluemap.com
Date: Thu, 9 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API quickstart — follow-up and next steps

Hi Emily — quick answers to the two asks and a couple of clarifications before the call: 

1) Streaming support: our hosted trial supports both HTTP chunked streaming and WebSocket-based streaming for interactive clients. We will include a streaming example (WS + JS client) in the quickstart ZIP.

2) Rate limits: default sandbox profile = 60 req/min with burst tokens up to 200 requests over a ~1 minute window to allow for quick testing. For production trials we can provision a higher trial quota after you share a traffic profile. Production quotas/SLAs are configurable per-account (e.g., Dedicated reservations vs Hosted tiers).

3) Data handling & logs: Hosted logs are retained per our standard settings (30 days) and can be restricted to US regions for the account. If you require extended retention or different retention, we can scope that into Dedicated/Private options in the MPA.

4) Next steps for the call: Lauren, could you lead the endpoint mapping and run through sample batching suggestions for Emily’s traffic profile?

I’ll provision the demo keys after this email and upload the quickstart bundle + the MPA to the drive link I shared.

Thanks — looking forward to Thursday.

Best,
Nikhil

> Thanks again for joining the demo this morning, Emily — really appreciated the candid discussion about BlueMap's latency targets and data residency needs. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we can keep momentum:
> ...

From: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily@bluemap.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>, BlueMap DevOps <devops@bluemap.com>, procurement@bluemap.com
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API quickstart — follow-up and next steps

Hi Emily + team — thanks for the quick responses and for looping procurement in. A few operational notes I’ll cover on the call and drop here so you have them in writing: 

- Sandbox details we’ll hand over: ephemeral API key, sandbox base URL (us-west), sample rate limits (60 req/min, burst up to 200), example connection TTLs for WS.
- Endpoints to validate on the call: /v1/generate (stream + non-stream), /v1/embeddings, /v1/re-ranking (if you want rerank workflow).
- Batching & cost: for your avg prompt/response sizes, 1:1 batching is fine; if you plan to parallelize many short queries, we’ll suggest small batches (4–8) to reduce token cost while keeping p95 under target.
- Observability: Sandbox includes per-request latency headers; for production we can turn on token-level cost breakdown in Console.
- Compliance: I attached the SOC 2 pointer doc to the Drive folder. For Private VPC/on-prem we can provide a checklist and onboarding timeline (generally 6–12 weeks depending on approvals).

Prep for Thurs: please paste a short CSV with columns (endpoint, avg_prompt_tokens, avg_response_tokens, steady_rps, peak_rps) into the shared Drive so I can run a quick projection during the meeting.

See you on Thu 3/9 10:00 PT — invite will follow.

Lauren
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
